name: Technology Advice

sources.title: List Your Product & Technology Company on TechnologyAdvice — vendor intake page (fetched via search snippet; direct fetch returned 403 bot-block). Describes free product profile + paid PPC 'Intent Clicks' + 'Traction' dashboard
B2B lead-gen overview (via search) — 'Get started with a free product profile on TechnologyAdvice.com ... Pay-per-click model, no up-front costs'

conditions: A free product profile on TechnologyAdvice.com is offered ('Get started with a free product profile'), but the vendor program is built around paid PPC 'Intent Clicks' campaigns and partnered review campaigns — expect sales-led onboarding rather than instant self-serve
requirements: B2B technology product/company — TechnologyAdvice is a B2B software review/comparison marketplace
Vendor intake goes through solutions.technologyadvice.com/list-your-product/ (form or live chat)
Listings are managed in 'Traction', TechnologyAdvice's vendor dashboard
preparation: Product name, category fit (they feature products 'across multiple categories'), website URL
Marketing copy and a custom header image for the branded profile
Target page to drive traffic to (site, trial, or demo page)
Contact details for the vendor team — onboarding appears sales-assisted
workflow: Submit the vendor form or use live chat to request the free product profile
Work with their team to publish the profile in the right categories on TechnologyAdvice.com
Optionally activate Intent Clicks PPC or a partnered review campaign (paid add-ons)
watchFor: Direct fetch of the vendor page 403s for bots — expect the form to be JS/CRM-backed; a human or full browser may be needed
Heavy lead-gen orientation: the funnel's purpose is selling PPC and review campaigns, so expect sales contact after submitting
B2B-only fit — consumer apps do not belong here
Confirm whether the free profile alone yields a public product page before spending effort
countsAsLive: A public product profile page exists on technologyadvice.com in the relevant software category, with branding and a link back to the product site
unknowns: Whether the free profile can be published fully self-serve or always requires sales contact
rel attributes on the product profile's outbound link
Review-collection mechanics on the free tier vs. paid partnered campaigns
